items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 is valid, 100 µL is handled by the p300, and the reservoir and plate are used correctly. The simulator checks all passed.
Each of the 12 transfers picks up a tip before aspirating and drops it after dispensing. The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks passed.
It transfers 100 µL from reservoir A1 to each of plate A1–A12 in order with no extra steps. Using a fresh tip per well is allowed, and the end_state:plate check passed.
The reservoir (slot 1) and plate (slot 2) are loaded with the specified labels. The p20 (left) and p300 (right) are loaded with the correct tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
The loop aspirates and dispenses 100 µL with p300 from reservoir A1 into plate A1–A12 only. The end_state:plate check passed.

judge.summary: The protocol correctly moves 100 µL with the p300 from reservoir A1 to plate wells A1–A12, using a fresh tip per well and dropping each one. All measured checks passed and no deviations from the task were found.
